definitions.explanation: one of the cardinal or intercardinal directions (north, south, east, west, etc.)
the direction a building or room faces, important in Japanese real estate

examples.english: If you go in this direction, you'll find the station.

examples.japanese: {方角|ほうがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からなく→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I lost my sense of direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方角|ほうがく}だ。
⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧とき、{方角|ほうがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The orientation is important when choosing a property.

notes:
{方角|ほうがく} refers specifically to compass directions (north, south, east, west) and the orientation of buildings. It is more specific than ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧, which means direction in a general sense.

CARDINAL DIRECTIONS:
- ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧: east
- ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧: west
- ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧: south
- ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧: north

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {方角|ほうがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to not know which direction
- ⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方角|ほうがく}: south-facing orientation
- {方角|ほうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the direction

REAL ESTATE USAGE:
In Japanese property listings, {方角|ほうがく} is a standard item. ⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧ (south-facing) is the most desirable orientation because rooms get the most sunlight throughout the day.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方角|ほうがく}: compass direction, orientation (specific to N/S/E/W)
- ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧: direction (general — "which way")
- ⟦{方位|ほうい}→方位：13047_houi⟧: compass bearing (more technical/precise)
- ⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧: facing, orientation (practical — ⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧)
